sqlMap.select: SELECT BUYER as BUYER , DOC_NO AS IF_NO , LPAD(TO_NUMBER(DOC_SEQ), 5 ,'0') AS IF_SEQ , BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE , UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE , ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY , ITEM_AMT AS ITEM_AMT , KEY_1 AS CURRENCY_CODE , KEY_2 AS BUDGET_DEPT , KEY_3 AS ASSET , PLANT AS PLANT , RD_DATE AS RD_DATE , LEGACY_USER_ID AS ADD_USER , KEY_4 AS KNTTP , KEY_5 AS ABRAD , KEY_6 AS WEMPF , KEY_7 AS ACCOUNT_TYPE , KEY_8 AS LGORT , KEY_9 AS COMPANY , KEY_10 AS PR_NO , LPAD(TO_NUMBER(DOC_SEQ), 5 ,'0') AS PR_SEQ , NVL(DOC_TYPE, ' ') AS DOC_TYPE FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'DWHA') AND IF_FLAG = 'T'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND SET IF_FLAG = #IF_FLAG# , IF_DATM = SYSDATE , MG_NOTE = MG_NOTE || #IF_MSG# WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'DWHA') AND DOC_NO = #IF_NO# AND DOC_SEQ = LPAD(TO_NUMBER(#IF_SEQ#), 6 ,'0')
